text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, it's a bit early, but time to 
get ready for training—"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, what should I do, what should I 
do...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up? Got a problem?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-senpai! Um~, I was supposed to help 
out with the farm work with my friends, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All the other girls caught colds or had 
sudden plans, so none of them could make 
it. What am I supposed to do all by 
myself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. Guess Palmer-san will step in and 
lend a hand here. Having one person's 
better than none, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Well, if it involves digging, leave 
it to me! Alright, let's head out to the 
fields right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(There's still time until training, so if 
I wrap this up real quick, I'll be 
fine...!)

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! Senpai, you're really good at 
tilling the fields!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Feels great, right?! Come on, come on, 
let's keep it going!"

And so, Mejiro Palmer got so absorbed in 
helping her junior that she completely 
bailed on training.
